matches.first_irreversible_signal: The opponent committed to 21 melons by day 8, but our fixed melon opener continued into the same crowded market.
matches.diagnosis: Opponent attention classified the expansion but did not alter the opening, so we accepted avoidable price competition.

matches.first_irreversible_signal: The crop-only rival left livestock value uncontested; our mixed engine moved ahead on day 27.
matches.diagnosis: The baseline works when diversification is uncontested and the opponent does not compound a second production system.

matches.first_irreversible_signal: We led after day 27, then sold feed, stopped hiring, and lost all four cows before the final bank comparison.
matches.diagnosis: The liquidation gate confused operating inventory with sale inventory. This is the highest-confidence execution bug.
